solution: $\cos3\theta=4\cos^3\theta-3\cos\theta$, so $\cos\theta+4\cos^3\theta-3\cos\theta=4\cos^3\theta-2\cos\theta=2\cos\theta(2\cos^2\theta-1)=0$. Hence $\cos\theta=0$ ($\theta=\tfrac{\pi}{2},\tfrac{3\pi}{2}$) or $\cos^2\theta=\tfrac12$ ($\theta=\tfrac{\pi}{4},\tfrac{3\pi}{4},\tfrac{5\pi}{4},\tfrac{7\pi}{4}$). Six solutions in total.
